Iran President phones PM Modi amid regional tensions

Iran's President contacted Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi following the funeral of Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei. Discussions reportedly touched upon regional issues, including the Strait of Hormuz and meetings with the United States. The call occurred amidst international attention on Iran's leadership transition and regional dynamics.
